$ kubectl rollout pause deploy/nginx
--- exit 1 (UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND)

$ kubectl rollout undo svc/web
--- exit 1 (UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: no rollout undo for services: the simulator supports rollouts of deployments only

$ kubectl set image deploy/nginx nope=nginx:1.27
--- exit 1 (NOT_FOUND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: unable to find container named "nope"

$ kubectl set image pod/typo web=nginx:1.27
--- exit 1 (UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: changing a Pod's containers in place isn't simulated; change its Deployment instead (Pods are replaced, not edited)

$ kubectl set image deploy/nginx
--- exit 1 (VALIDATION_FAILED)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: at least one image update is required, e.g. kubectl set image deployment/web nginx=nginx:1.27

$ kubectl set resources deploy/nginx --limits=cpu=200m
--- exit 1 (UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND)
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: 'kubectl set resources' isn't supported yet; change resources in the manifest and use kubectl apply -f
